instruction: A blooming lotus assembled from dozens of folded paper petals layered in concentric rings around a beaded card center. Each petal is a flat pink-to-white gradient sheet with visible score lines and slightly curled tips. Small tab-and-glue seams and crisp folded edges reveal its handmade cut-paper construction as it opens symmetrically.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Papercraft Lotus Flower in a papercraft style.
